title: AVX Finding
description: A Tier 2 agent finding. Exactly one scope field must be populated (see scope.$defs.oneOf). Spec source: specs/2026-09-18-avx-tier2-ios-cards-and-actions/spec.md § 'Cross-surface Action data model — canonical' including Contract Addenda D1–D2.

finding_id.description: Stable UUID. Preserved across in-place updates (Addendum D2). Format: FIND-{uuid}

finding_key.description: SHA-256 of canonicalised (agent_id, scope_field, scope_value, finding_kind). Stable identity of an open condition on a scope. The writer queries on this GSI to decide UpdateItem (persistent condition still open) vs PutItem (new condition). Addendum D2.

agent_id.description: Identifies the agent that produced this finding.

agent_version.description: Semver string, pinned per artifact write.

scope.description: Exactly one of {vin, owner_id, fleet_id, dealership_id, district_id} must be populated. Per-persona writer rule (Addendum D1): consumer/vehicle_owner personas use scope.vin; fleet_owner persona uses scope.fleet_id (one fleet-scoped Finding per finding_kind with per-VIN evidence[]); dealership_id/district_id reserved for Spec 2.

computed_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when the finding was computed.

expires_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp. computed_at + agent freshness TTL. Extended in place on re-emit (Addendum D2).

finding_kind.description: Categorises the finding. Spec 1a scope: health.*. Spec 1b appends energy.*, coverage.*, loyalty.*, concierge.*. health.diagnostics (spec 2026-09-25-avx-own-vehicle-findings) covers active fault codes outside tires, brakes and battery.

detail.description: Markdown-formatted detail. LLM-generated, may embed evidence citations.

evidence.description: Evidence entries that support this finding. May be empty (absent-data scenario). For fleet_id-scoped Findings, each entry carries a per-entry 'vin' attribution field (Addendum D1).

inputs_hash.description: SHA-256 of canonicalised input rows. ROLE (Addendum D2): retry-safety within a single agent execution attempt. Cross-run idempotency is finding_key-based. Updated in-place on re-emit.

tokens_used.description: Token count. 0 iff the deterministic fallback ran.

cost_usd.description: Inference cost in USD. 0.0 iff the deterministic fallback ran.

disclosure_txt.description: Verbatim disclosure copy, populated only when the finding surfaces a monetary figure (parent PRD § M8). Not present for Spec 1a Agent 2 health findings.

audit_trail.description: In-place update history. Appended on every UpdateItem (in-place re-emit) so persistence history is reconstructable from the Finding alone. Addendum D2.

allOf.$comment: Addendum D1: fleet_id-scoped Finding must carry per-VIN evidence entries (minItems:1, each entry requires vin). The vin requirement sits under items, which JSON Schema evaluates vacuously on an empty array — minItems:1 is what makes the fleet-aggregation guarantee non-vacuous.

Contract Addendum C3 / security review S1 (contract v2.2): monetary finding_kind values MUST carry non-empty disclosure_txt. Parent PRD § M8, § M14 require verbatim disclosure copy on monetary output. Spec 1a Agent 2 emits no monetary Findings so this if/then never fires in Spec 1a; Spec 1b Agent 3 inherits this schema by reference and will produce findings where finding_kind ∈ {coverage.warranty, coverage.recall, energy.cost, loyalty.points, loyalty.expiry}. A monetary Finding lacking disclosure_txt would validate silently without this guard — the same class of defect as the D5 failure_kind gap in v1 (declared but not bound). The guard is cheapest to add now because Spec 1b re-freezing mid-flight breaks byte-identity for downstream inheritors.

scope.description: Finding scope. Exactly one field must be populated (enforced by oneOf). A Finding with zero or two-or-more scope fields is a schema bug.

fleet_id.description: Fleet-scoped finding. Agent 2 fleet_owner persona writes one per (fleet_id, finding_kind) with per-VIN evidence entries (Addendum D1).

dealership_id.description: Dealership-scoped finding. Populated by Spec 2 writers.

district_id.description: District-scoped finding. Populated by Spec 2 writers.

source.description: System that produced this evidence entry.

source_ref.description: Opaque reference to the source record (e.g. Athena query ID, DMS RO number).

value.description: The evidence value. Any JSON-serialisable type.

computed_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when this evidence was collected.

provenance.description: Data provenance. 'mocked' required for Spec 1b Agent 3 mocked partner seams (parent PRD § M14). Spec 1a Agent 2 uses 'live' only, but 'mocked' must be an accepted value.

vin.description: Optional per-VIN attribution for fleet_id-scoped Findings. For fleet-scoped Findings, each evidence entry carries the specific VIN it pertains to so the iOS renderer can surface per-vehicle details. Addendum D1.

at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the in-place update.

agent_version.description: Agent version that wrote this update.

inputs_hash.description: inputs_hash of the update run that produced this entry.

note.description: Optional human-readable note for the update.
